full_judgment: “Where the amendment does not constitute the addition of a new cause of action or raise a different case, but amounts to no more than a different or additional approach to the same facts, the amendment will be allowed even after the expiry of the statutory period of limitation the object of Courts and rules of procedure is to decide the rights of the parties and not to punish them for their mistakes.”
